decisions.briefing: NASDAQ fell 1.1% and the S&P 500 dropped 0.7% today, putting the market in a risk-off state with no new stock candidates cleared for buying. Held all 7 existing positions unchanged and kept the $289.29 cash reserve on the sidelines rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices pulled back today, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500, a pattern typically seen when investors rotate out of higher-growth, higher-valuation names during risk-off sessions. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session, so this move reflects general market-wide selling pressure rather than a single catalyst. Days like this call for patience rather than reactive selling of quality positions.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走弱，納斯達克指數跌幅(-1.1%)大於標普500指數(-0.7%)，這是典型的風險趨避情緒下，資金從高估值成長股撤出的走勢。由於今日未提供具體新聞標題，此次下跌反映的是大盤整體賣壓，而非單一事件所致。面對這類日子，投資人應保持耐心，而非急於出脫優質持股。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Risk-off' describes a market mood where investors pull back from riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safety, often causing broad indices to fall together. On risk-off days, it's usually better to hold existing positions and avoid chasing new buys until conditions stabilize.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險趨避」（Risk-Off）指投資人情緒轉趨保守，紛紛賣出成長股等風險性資產、轉向較安全的資產，導致大盤指數普遍下跌。在這類日子裡，通常最好的做法是持有現有部位、避免追加新的買進，直到市況穩定為止。
